dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hmm, you know... We've encountered a lot of interesting animals lately!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: But they're not exactly the types of animals you can play with. They're either super big or super... wet. Anyway, Paimon wants to play with something small, cute, and cuddly. Ooh, like a cat!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #How about we head to The Cat's Tail in Mondstadt and have a look around, {NICKNAME}?
